name: Setup Julia environment
description: Setup a Julia environment and add it to the PATH

version.description: The Julia version to download (if necessary) and use. Use a string input to avoid unwanted decimal conversion e.g. 1.10 without quotes will be interpreted as 1.

include-all-prereleases.description: Include prereleases when matching the Julia version to available versions.

arch.description: Architecture of the Julia binaries. Defaults to the architecture of the runner executing the job.

project.description: The path to the project directory or file to use when resolving some versions (e.g. min)
